name: collection
title: Collection
description: Bordered lists with headers, avatars, secondary content and link collections.
improvements: Real list semantics: ul/li for collections, and nav > ul > li > a for link collections.
The active link gets aria-current="page", not just a color.
Secondary content is laid out with flexbox instead of floats, so it stays aligned at any height.
Visible keyboard focus for links and dark-mode aware borders and surfaces.
